description.value: Japanese sushi and grill restaurant in Surrey with online ordering and to-go service. A convenient refueling stop for touring cyclists passing through the area.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Maguroguy Sushi & Grill is confirmed as an open restaurant via website displaying 'NOW TAKING ONLINE ORDERS' and explicit to-go service ('10% off on every to go order'). Website and OSM address/URL corroborate the listing as real and operating. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) are mentioned in OSM tags or website content.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open restaurant offering takeout service. A legitimate refueling stop for touring cyclists regardless of undocumented bike amenities.
